newsitem.title: SAUDI ARABIA: Saudi beheads Sudanese killer, two drug smugglers.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Sudanese killer, two drug smugglers.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Friday beheaded a Sudanese murderer and two drug smugglers from Syria and Jordan, the Saudi Interior Ministry said.
A ministry statement carried on state-run television said the Sudanese man was executed in Asir region after being found guilty of breaking into three homes and killing five people.
Another ministry statement said the Saudi authorities also beheaded a Syrian man and a Jordanian man on Friday in al-Jawf region after they were convicted for smuggling hashish into the kingdom.
The beheadings raised to 19 the number of people executed in the conservative Islamic kingdom so far this year.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
